classification_legend.SUPPORTED: exact public command plus sufficient structured arguments, result, effect, timeout and recovery semantics for the required capability.
classification_legend.PARTIAL: exact public command exists but one or more required semantics are not publicly structured.
classification_legend.MISSING: no public structured command satisfies the required capability.
classification_legend.UNKNOWN: catalog evidence cannot decide without executing an operation or consulting non-authoritative/private material.
